name: A Christmas Cutie
source:
A short and stupid linear visual novel about a Christmas Elf teaching a generic protagonist about the joy of Christmas.

[From [url=https://natspectrum.itch.io/a-christmas-cutie]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部又短又傻的線性視覺小說，講的是一個聖誕精靈教一位毫無特色的主角體會聖誕節的快樂。
